decisions.reason: As the flagship and central to the announced direction, high sunk costs and public commitment make withdrawal highly unlikely.
Its own product page and established-offer integration sustain visible commitment and justify continued investment.
Although less visible, its integration role and accumulated R&D keep the firm persisting.
Secure messaging alignment and prior investment outweigh limited visibility, supporting persistence.
As a low-visibility feature close to the established offer, it has the weakest escalation pull yet sunk costs and continuity favor keeping.
